purpose: Build a prompt-to-token-to-output mental model for probabilistic generation.
input_contract: Learner predicts what the model does after receiving context.
output_contract: Learner distinguishes next-token generation from deterministic lookup and guaranteed truth.

purpose: Choose models and deployment patterns from workload, modality, data-processing, traffic, and latency requirements.
output_contract: Learner justifies a capability and deployment choice without selecting by model popularity alone.

purpose: Retrieve model, deployment, and parameter decisions on primary and transfer forms.
input_contract: Learner completes each form closed-note before hints.
output_contract: Deterministic validator records decision and reason correctness without retaining free-form explanation.
